reviewer: Root Codex assistant; separate from MiniMax author and source auditor, not qualified human legal review.
method: Read all final titles, content and structured ruling fields against the fictional approved account, pinned setup, actor roles, authorized procedural events and prior statements. Review source meaning separately from automated acceptance; mechanical/hash checks reported in evidence-summary.json.
scope: Final accepted outputs only; raw original drafts and prior failures retained separately. No actual-law or merits grading.
